arm_controller: world-frame damped-least-squares IK retaining a right-hand ascender grasp plus learned force-balanced Jumar loading; relaxed left balance arm
uphill_force_source: coordinated position-actuated leg motion through MuJoCo boot/slope contact and a learned right-wrist Jumar pull with equal-and-opposite reaction on the deformable fixed line
selection_rule: best deterministic EvalCallback reward, followed by the causal and contact-load gates in evaluate_fixed_line.py
